SELECT u.* FROM sys_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_key = 'DOCTOR')
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.realName}, '%')
AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.phone}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM doctor_profile p WHERE p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.license_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.licenseNo}, '%'))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM doctor_profile p2 WHERE p2.user_id = u.id AND p2.deleted = 0)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM doctor_profile p3 WHERE p3.user_id = u.id AND p3.deleted = 0)
AND u.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC, u.id DESC

SELECT p.id, u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.phone, u.title, u.hospital, u.department, p.position, p.specialty, p.license_no, p.license_type, p.practice_scope, p.cert_no, p.issuing_authority, p.license_expire_date, p.introduction, p.experience, p.schedule, p.registration_fee, p.max_patients, u.status, p.update_time, CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_profile FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN doctor_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS profiled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unprofiled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.schedule IS NOT NULL AND p.schedule != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS scheduled FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN doctor_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role x INNER JOIN sys_role r2 ON r2.id = x.role_id AND r2.deleted = 0 WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND r2.role_key = 'DOCTOR')
